frozen: 2026-10-23, after the heat-diffusion plan failed (S 1.0005 / 1.0010: no effect) and before any result of this plan

findings.rain: Under r33 the local (within-region) share of the rainfall error is 54 %. The annual log10 rain error of each cell falls by -0.27 per km of sub-grid relief (the cell's highest minus mean ground), negative in nearly every region (Patagonia -0.84, SW Australia -0.83, north India -0.36, Mexico -0.25): hilly cells are too dry.
findings.temperature: The within-region temperature error says the solved field is too smooth (coast-interior -1.2 C per decade of distance, latitude +0.12 C/deg), but the horizontal diffusion is not the cause.

hypotheses.e34: Sub-grid hills force ascent whatever the wind direction; add subgrid_orographic x relief_km x wind/5 m/s to the rain ascent (rain stays a sink of the solved vapour).
hypotheses.eddy_heat: The storm-eddy exchange relaxes temperature toward its ~850 km Gaussian surroundings (eddy_heat 1.0, eddy_scale_km 852): the stronger smoother. Weaken its heat part.
